structured.answer: A פיקדון means the bank holds your money for a set time and pays interest, and you only get it back at the end or on an exit date. Breaking it early costs a fine the page doesn't put a number on, and it can eat the interest and even part of what you put in. The example also seemed to show me ending with 68,270 ₪ after putting in 70,000 ₪, so I'm not keen.
